name: Phenadoxone
summary: Phenadoxone (trade names Heptalgin, Morphidone, and Heptazone) is an opioid analgesic of the open chain class (methadone and relatives) invented in Germany by Hoechst in 1947.

uses.text: It is one of a handful of useful synthetic analgesics which were used in the United States for various lengths of time in the 20 or so years after the end of the Second World War but which were withdrawn from the market for various or no known reason and which now are mostly in Schedule I of the United States' Controlled Substances Act of 1970, or (like phenazocine and bezitramide) in Schedule II but not produced or marketed in the US.

summaryZh: 苯嗎庚酮是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C23H29NO2，能作為阿片類止痛藥，結構上與美沙酮類似，1947年由德國赫斯特公司研發。
summaryZhHans: 苯吗庚酮是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C23H29NO2，能作为阿片类止痛药，结构上与美沙酮类似，1947年由德国赫斯特公司研发。

pharmacology.en: It acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, as methadone does.
pharmacology.zh: 與美沙酮一樣，它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与美沙酮一样，它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It was invented at Hoechst in Germany in 1947, in the same open chain family as methadone, which that company had made during the war.
fact.zh: 它在 1947 年由德國赫斯特公司發明，與該公司戰時合成的美沙酮屬於同一類開鏈結構。
fact.zhHans: 它在 1947 年由德国赫斯特公司发明，与该公司战时合成的美沙酮属于同一类开链结构。
